steps.en: Clone the text only, skipping the ~2 GB of LFS binaries
steps.zh: 只克隆文本，跳过约 2 GB 的 LFS 二进制

steps.en: 68 skill folders from Meta's Muse agent, grouped by domain in the README catalog
steps.zh: Muse agent 的 68 个 skill 目录，README 按领域分类

steps.en: Pick one skill and read its instructions, then its permission manifest and eval scenarios
steps.zh: 挑一个 skill，先读指令，再读权限清单和评测场景

steps.en: Shows how a shipped agent scopes triggers, asks before writes, and verifies deliverables
steps.zh: 展示已上线 agent 怎样限定触发、先问再写、验收交付

steps.en: Rewrite the pattern for your own harness: tool names, paths, auth and checks
steps.zh: 按自己的 harness 重写这套模式：工具名、路径、授权与验收

value.en: You see a production consumer agent's skill design without reverse-engineering it — patterns to rewrite, not skills to install
value.zh: 不用自己逆向，就能看到一个已上线消费级 agent 的 skill 设计——得到的是要重写的模式，不是能装的 skill
